name: Shree Metalloys Limited
about: Shree Metalloys Limited trades in ferrous and non-ferrous primarily in India. The company also offers brass, bronze, and copper alloys; and manufactures and sells non-ferrous metals. The company was formerly known as Valley Indiana Leisure Limited and changed its name to Shree Metalloys Limited in March 2011. Shree Metalloys Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
